text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A French appeals court found the French newspaper Le Monde guilty of offending King Hassan in a report.
- The body of a Moroccan-born girl Loubna Benaissa was found in a trunk under a garage near her home in Brussels.
- Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro to visit Morocco on March 18.
- Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed inaugurates telecommunications headquarters in Rabat.
